text:
alisha: Kicking off canary for schema migration user_profiles.add_city in prod-west (slot 03). Deploybot will run 500 rows via backfill. Watching locks + latency. @jamie @micah please ack :eyes:

deploybot: Canary started: cb-1829993333
 - target hosts: prod-west-3
 - rows: 500
 - timeout: 15m

jamie: ack. I'll watch DB locks. setting read_replicas to on for canary shards?

micah: seeing lock spike on replica 2 already, 95th write latency +250ms. mark hold if >200ms for 2m

luis: recommend pinning service version to 1.42.3 to avoid new client migrations. If we pause, enable feature flag `city_lookup_v2=false`.

alisha: ok pausing canary now -> `deploybot pause cb-1829993333`

deploybot: Canary cb-1829993333 paused by alisha at 1829993380. progress: 120/500 rows applied.

jamie: logs show occasional deadlock: stacktrace snippet:
```
ERROR: deadlock detected
DETAIL: process 3245 waits for sharelock
```

micah: ok run a quick smoke rollback on affected shard only, not full rollback. propose command:
```
deploybot rollback --canary cb-1829993333 --shard prod-west-3-2 --dry-run=false
```

luis: +1 to targeted rollback. then re-run with batching=50 and KV-cache disabled.

alisha: executing targeted rollback now. will re-run canary with batching tuned. notifying product for release notes update.

deploybot: Rollback started for shard prod-west-3-2 (canary cb-1829993333). ETA 2m.

oncall-bot: Pager duty alert suppressed (maintenance window). Remember to update runbook: `docs/runbooks/canary-migrations.md`

alisha: rollback complete. rows rolled back: 120. No other shards affected. Re-scheduling canary for 10m with batching=50, pin app=1.42.3, featureflag city_lookup_v2=false. Anyone object?

jamie: no objections. I'll keep watch and escalate if locks >200ms for 3 consecutive intervals.

micah: logging postmortem note in incident tracker: http://confluence/reports/1829993333

alisha: thanks team. closing thread once canary finishes.
